content.text: Nonsevere initial episode or first recurr: either metronidazole or vanco; metronidazole x10D (PO) or vanco x10D (PO). Severe initial episode: PO vanco over metronidazole. Second or later recurr: PO vanco over metronidazole. Fidaxomicin (label): indicated in pediatric pts ≥ 6 mo for C. diff-associated diarrhea; ≥ 12.5 kg and able to swallow tablets: one 200 mg tablet PO BID for 10 days.
